plans.ligne: Your setter books calls that never close? Don't fire him, he's drowning in flakes. Let ManySetter answer the flakes, so he works the serious ones.
plans.jeu: [0-2 s] already fed up, leans toward the lens, eyebrows raised, palm up. [2-5 s] shakes his head, sweeps his free hand over his head, glance at the side window then back. [5-8 s] points at the lens, firm hand chop, confident half smile.
plans.prompt_veo: Vertical 9:16 iPhone front camera selfie, UGC style, handheld at arm's length with slight natural hand shake. The man from the start frame sits in the driver's seat of his parked car outside the gym, overcast daylight through the windshield, the parking lot behind him soft and barely readable. Natural skin with visible pores, a slight shine on his forehead, light freckles. [00:00-00:02] Already fed up, he leans toward the lens, eyebrows raised, palm up, and says: "Your setter books calls that never close?" [00:02-00:05] He shakes his head, then sweeps his free hand over his head: "Don't fire him, he's drowning in flakes." His eyes flick to the side window for a split second, then back to the lens. [00:05-00:08] He points at the lens, a firm hand chop, then a confident half smile: "Let ManySetter answer the flakes, so he works the serious ones." Voice: warm American male voice, mid-low pitch, projects his voice like a creator ranting in his car, fast and casual, like a voice note to a friend, no long pauses. SFX: the soft creak of the car seat as he leans in. Ambient noise: muffled parking lot sounds, a car door closing in the distance, quiet car interior with the engine off. One continuous take, no cuts. Clean frame with nothing written on screen.

voix: His voice: warm American male voice, mid-low pitch, relaxed but quick and confident delivery, dry playful humor, clear diction, natural pauses, no vocal fry, General American accent.
cadrage: selfie dans sa voiture garée devant la salle de sport, ceinture, volant visible, décor à peine lisible
